reason: A source-level DeepSeek Harness skin system that adds 21 built-in themes and generates custom color schemes from local images, with selectable UI styling and an update check.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 21 套内置皮肤，并支持从本地图片生成可切换的自定义界面配色。
summaries.en: Adds 21 built-in skins to DeepSeek Harness and generates selectable custom interface color schemes from local images.

capabilities: Modifies DeepSeek Harness source files during installation
Adds selectable built-in and image-derived UI themes
Processes selected images locally and stores compressed WebP files under the user home directory
Checks GitHub Releases for updates through the DSH Host proxy
